_comment: Run this with: python3 scraper.py --params params.example.json
countries[].name must match the display name in ICF's Locations modal.
Optional filters (all default to no-filter / all-matching):
credentials       — any of 'ACC','PCC','MCC','ACTC'. ACTC has no
checkbox on the ICF UI, so the scraper runs the
broader search and the Airtable writer filters
for ACTC presence on the coach record when
languages         — exact display names from ICF's Fluent Languages
industry_sectors  — any of the 11 ICF sectors (multi-select)
